items.label: Post 1 deferred Reddit card
items.description: Drain one acceptance/veto post from the Devvit deferred queue

postCardSecret.label: Bridge secret for /api/post-card (in-app only)
postCardSecret.helpText: External GCP callers use a managed App Token (devvit_at_…), not this setting.

hellfallApiUrl.label: Hellfall API base URL
hellfallApiUrl.helpText: Base for COTD search (default https://api.skeleton.club). Must be HTTP-fetch allow-listed.

officialHcRedditFlair.label: Official HC Reddit flair ID
officialHcRedditFlair.helpText: Flair UUID for COTD and default /post-card flair when omitted. Set via devvit settings set.

cardOfTheDayViaDevvit.label: Card of the day via Devvit
cardOfTheDayViaDevvit.helpText: Scheduler posts HC6 card-of-the-day via Hellfall search. Pair with REDDIT_COTD_VIA_DEVVIT=1 on the Discord bot.

redditMirrorWebhookUrl.label: Discord webhook URL for #reddit mirroring
redditMirrorWebhookUrl.helpText: https://discord.com/api/webhooks/… for PostSubmit → #reddit. Set via devvit settings set.

redditMirrorViaDevvit.label: Mirror inbound Reddit posts via Devvit
redditMirrorViaDevvit.helpText: PostSubmit → #reddit webhook. Pair with REDDIT_MIRROR_VIA_DEVVIT=1 on the Discord bot.

submissionsGalleryManifestUrl.label: Submissions gallery manifest URL (unused)
submissionsGalleryManifestUrl.helpText: Unused. Gallery pictures are POSTed to /external/post-gallery.

dailyGalleryViaDevvit.label: Daily submissions gallery via Devvit (unused)
dailyGalleryViaDevvit.helpText: Unused. Mork posts via /external/post-gallery when REDDIT_GALLERY_VIA_DEVVIT=1.
